title: PreorderCommandsStepV1
description: Shared envelope shape for every internal pre-order saga step AFTER start (spec 11 §5.3) on the preorder.commands lane (consumer 'preorder.processor'). Under the booking-delegated design (booking — capacity/07, payment/09, provider-create/06 — is owned by the spec-06 engine) the saga's own steps are: reserve_items, commit_preorder, compensate_items, compensate_booking, and reconcile — each a distinct message_type sharing this shape. (The 06 → saga terminal signals booking_committed.v1 / booking_failed.v1 are resolved by operation_id and use their own schemas, not this envelope.) Carries ONLY the saga + operation ids (Inv-12); the handler reloads the saga row for the immutable reference + step checkpoints. Each is inbox-deduplicated and idempotent under duplicate delivery (Inv-5/Inv-9).

message_type.description: One of the preorder.commands.* step types.

saga_id.description: The preorder_sagas row this step advances.

correlation_id.description: Correlation id propagated across the saga chain.
